static_traits.name: Lin Kai
static_traits.educational_background: Having taken cooking classes while growing up
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with friends and family strained by negative self-evaluation; although having a few relatives and friends to talk to, finding it hard to share Self-doubt and Fear of failure
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; never sought treatment or counseling for these symptoms before; long-term experience of failure and Self-doubt when facing rejection or setbacks (especially cooking-related)
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to concretely describe emotions and events; tone neutral but with a sense of frustration; relatively high cooperation; when talking about negative feelings tends toward restraint and self-closure

basic_info.main_problem: After failing an audition recently, I have been struggling with feelings of failure and Self-doubt, these feelings continuing since childhood, intensifying in recent months.
basic_info.core_demands: Hoping to find ways to break the cycle of Self-doubt and Fear of failure, improving motivation and mental health.
growth_experiences: In childhood cooking classes, when things did not go as planned, strong feelings of failure and Self-doubt appeared, this pattern continuing to this day.

In adulthood, when facing rejection or setbacks in cooking-related auditions or new projects, similar negative experiences recurred; never sought treatment, gradually internalized into the Anticipation of 'I will fail'.

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one audition fails, it means I will never succeed, I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Shuts himself down, reduces attempts, and avoids new auditions to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I fail every time / I am never good enough

special_situations.event: Making mistakes in a new cooking project or things not going as planned
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If problems arise in the project, it proves I lack ability, and things will only get worse
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pauses projects, reduces innovation and challenges, avoids possible mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This failure foretells that everything will go wrong

special_situations.event: Facing rejection or Receiving negative feedback (such as failing an audition)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If Being rejected, it means I am a failure, all my attempts will fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Lowers goals, refuses new opportunities, avoids risk

special_situations.event: Thinking about sharing Self-doubt and feelings of failure when interacting with friends or family
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express these feelings, others will think I am weak and look down on me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids sharing and in-depth communication, keeping a surface normality to reduce negative evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Saying it will only make the relationship worse

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and seen, to prove her own value and ability
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and Being rejected, being seen as weak or not good enough
defense_goal: Reducing the possibility of shame and being negated by staying closed off and Avoiding challenges
Avoids exposing vulnerability to others to maintain a sense of security

object_relations.object_representation: Critical others who may reject and belittle (reviewers, relatives and friends)
A person who will see me as weak

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited or expected to share Self-doubt and feelings of failure in depth during counseling
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding exposure of vulnerability as being looked down on or negated, thus tending to avoid expressing (transference: worrying about being judged as weak)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tone steady but restrained, reduces emotion vocabulary, downplays negative experiences, avoids staying on emotional details for long

manifestations: Long-term Self-doubt and feelings of failure leading to Decreased motivation, difficulty maintaining cooking-related daily activities
Although there are family and friends to talk to, worries about appearing weak and avoids sharing troubles

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains impulses that should be expressed outwardly or seek others' help, Turning against the self with the energy (corresponding to 'impulse').
manifestations: After a setback, 'shuts down', stopping action and communication
Could have sought support but chose to bear it alone

contact_model.definition: Poor self-Reflection includes excessive self-limitation and harsh reproach, being overly cautious about contact (corresponding to 'autonomy').
manifestations: Worries that expressing oneself will seem weak or like complaining
Over-scrutinizes own words and actions, cautious to the point of affecting genuine contact

positive_force: Has some cooking training and practical experience (took cooking courses while growing up)
Willing to seek help and accept counseling, willing to try behavioral experiments
Has a small support network of family and friends to talk to
negative_force: Catastrophizing, overgeneralization, future prediction, mental filtering and other negative cognitive patterns
Highly sensitive to rejection and setbacks, easily shuts down when encountering frustration
Avoiding challenges and expressing vulnerability, relying on avoidance to reduce Anxiety
Low self-evaluation, often defining self with 'I am not good enough'

target_behavior.behavior: After encountering failure or rejection, 'self-shutdown' appears and one avoids new attempts
antecedent: Mistakes in a new cooking project
Receiving negative feedback or Being rejected
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic Interpretation of failure and the overgeneralized belief of 'I am not good enough / I will always fail'
target_behavior.function: Escaping further failure and shame, temporarily reducing Anxiety and stress
target_behavior.consequence: Motivation drops markedly, affecting auditions and new project performance; daily cooking activities blocked

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding sharing Self-doubt and feelings of failure with relatives and friends
antecedent: Being asked about recent life when interacting with friends or family
When needing to talk about failure experiences or emotions
target_behavior.core_reason: Predicting others will evaluate oneself negatively, believing expressing vulnerability equals weakness (future prediction, mental filtering)
target_behavior.function: Avoiding being looked down on and relationship deterioration, maintaining a surface sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal tension, receiving Decreased support, Increased sense of isolation
